title: Wanted to like it, just not sturdy
text:
Wanted to like it, just not sturdy. This is such a big nice spoon rest. Great heavy duty, LOVED IT COMING OUT OF THE BOX.
Then I sat it on the counter and watched it as the counter weight on it was wrong and it just wobbled back and forth.
The handle on this causes the entire thing to be off balance and a spoon with any weight to it would tip it.
I probably wont return it, I can use it on the table to put spoons in when serving. Just wouldn’t be suitable to have on a countertop or stove, would most likely end up on my toe.
